name: data-engineering-skills
description: Skills for data engineering, software quality, architecture, and agent-assisted workflows.

plugins.name: architecture-baseline
plugins.description: Establish architectural constraints before feature work. Requires the separately installed researcher agent.

plugins.name: code-audit
plugins.description: Produce non-destructive, language-agnostic code audits with scored JSON findings and optional Markdown reports.

plugins.name: data-governance
plugins.description: Query Snowflake ACCOUNT_USAGE for masking, row access, classification, tags, access history, grants, logins, and query auditing.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Pressure-test and sharpen change ideas, plans, specs, ADRs, PRDs, and similar artifacts before implementation.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Drive workers to implement bounded plans. Requires the separately installed implementer, pathfinder, and researcher agents.

plugins.name: python-engineering-standards
plugins.description: Apply canonical Python standards for structure, typing, documentation, reliability, security, concurrency, and testing.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Explore undecided problems through delegated research. Requires the separately installed pathfinder and researcher agents.

plugins.name: sql-data-analysis
plugins.description: Apply canonical SQL standards for trustworthy analytics, transformations, reviews, performance, and cost control.

plugins.name: stash
plugins.description: Park raw conversation or pasted content in an Obsidian vault inbox for later processing.

plugins.name: structure-review
plugins.description: Review a finished change for structure, architectural conformance, test design, naming, and maintainability before approval.

plugins.name: write-ticket
plugins.description: Create Jira tickets and comments in plain, human-sounding language through the Atlassian MCP.
